svg.title: Average Chrome RAM during speech generation — Ukrainian
svg.desc: Separate full-article diagnostics. Owned Chrome process-tree RSS includes browser baseline and workers. Decimal megabytes; lower uses less memory. Unsupported backends have no bar.

g.text: Chrome RAM · Ukrainian full article diagnostics
One isolated Chrome instance · includes workers and browser baseline · excludes loading and audio export
RAM 1 · uk-article-v1 · MacBook Pro (Apple M1 Pro, 16 GB, native arm64; macOS 26.6.2) · n=1 article(s)
Sample means, not model-only RAM or GPU VRAM. RSS may double-count shared pages. Timing scores are reported separately.
